mentions.name: Beehive ATS
mentions.description: An applicant tracking system (ATS) that integrates LLMs to assist recruiters: it helps write job descriptions, parses CVs into Markdown, generates CV summaries, and suggests which candidates best match job offers with pluses and minuses.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on an ATS system that integrates LLMs for helping the recruiter in writing job descriptions, parsing CVs to Markdown, making summaries of CVs and suggest which ones match the best the job offers giving pluses and minus: https://beehive-ats.com/
